title: The Sinking Road
text: The causeway is slowly going under, the black water lapping over the stones and creeping higher. Things move in the water on both sides. You have to cross before the road is gone.

options.label: Run for it before the road is gone.

outcomes.text: Everyone gets across, muddy to the knees, with something in the water just behind.
The water catches the slowest, and so does what moves in it.

options.label: The slowest goes first while there is still road, so no one is left behind.

outcomes.text: They make it, though the last one through has to swim. Everyone is chilled to a crawl.

options.label: Camp and wait for the tide to turn; the road will rise again.

outcomes.text: It is a long cold night of listening to things move in the water.
